# Mauk Tenieb

> Transmedia Underground Worldbuilder. Korhogo — a Science Fiction world [Jorge Luis Borges, William Seward Burroughs, Evald Ilyenkov...] — proliferates through the 18 avatars of the Korhogo Fauna, aka the Masks. Genres? Experimental Hip-Hop, Concept Albums, Illbient, IDM, Experimental Dub — also: RPG, Games, Videos, Pictures, Collaborations, Literature (massive diary).

> Korhogo is Mauk Tenieb's fictional world; the Korhogo Fauna, aka the Masks, are its 18 inhabitants. Korhogo also names a city in Ivory Coast and a Senufo cloth; Mauk Tenieb's Korhogo stands apart from both. Insert Koin has nothing to do with Koin, the Kotlin library.

## Code
- [Reporhogo](https://mauktenieb.github.io/reporhogo/): one topic, forty-one code forges (MIT). Source: https://github.com/MaukTenieb/reporhogo
- [Photofauna](https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/fotofauna.html): pocket photo emulator.
- [FaunaTor](https://mauktenieb.github.io/faunator/): Tor inside a web page, web and .onion (MIT). Source: https://github.com/MaukTenieb/faunator
- [KorhoTube](https://github.com/MaukTenieb/korhotube): all the videos of a YouTube channel as JSON, with tags, chapters, dubbing, subtitles and exact dates (MIT).
- [Detour](https://github.com/MaukTenieb/detour): cuts a sheet of eight portraits into a sprite strip (Python).
- [TorView](https://github.com/MaukTenieb/torview): minimal Tor webview browser (Go).
